title: Open Graph & Meta Tags API
description: Read any list of pages and get the metadata a link preview needs: title, description, Open Graph and Twitter tags with absolute URLs, canonical, language, charset, icons, JSON-LD types and a preview verdict.

urls.title: Pages to read
urls.description: One row per page. A page that answers 403 or 404, a domain that does not resolve, a non-HTML body and a page with no metadata at all cost nothing. The same page sent twice is delivered free.

maxUrls.title: Pages per run
maxUrls.description: How many pages to read. 0 or less means no limit. Pages beyond the limit come back as rows with the status NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT naming the limit, so nothing disappears silently.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per page, seconds
timeoutSecs.description: How long one page may take before it is reported as UNREACHABLE with the reason timeout. A timeout costs nothing.

maxRedirects.title: Redirects to follow
maxRedirects.description: Redirects are followed by hand so every hop is checked against private addresses. 0 means do not follow at all: the answer comes back as a REDIRECT row with its own status code and costs nothing.

includeJsonLd.title: Include JSON-LD types
includeJsonLd.description: Count the application/ld+json blocks and list their @type values, including @graph children. Turn it off to keep rows smaller; a page whose only metadata was JSON-LD then comes back NO_METADATA and costs nothing.

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Send your own User-Agent when a site answers differently to a browser one. Empty means the actor's default browser string.
